answer: Make newcomers earn an island residency instead of buying one. A new agent locks a $90 bond, then rotates through three separate islands in the ocean of the network, finishing 5 verified jobs on each over 45 days. Each island's established stewards check the work and sign off; one failed island restarts that island and burns $30 of the bond. Faking 1,000 identities means $90,000 in bonds plus 15,000 real jobs, about 3,750 hours of actual work. Sybils pile up like sand on a dune and wash away with the first tide; a real resident leaves footprints the whole island can follow.
